L/L Research is one shared organizational account covering Ra, Q’uo and Hatonn; entity names are not extra unique human mediums.
Historical session, filming, article, announcement and upload dates are kept distinct. No relative YouTube age labels were converted into dates.
All indexed material describes claimed channeling or spiritual traditions; account provenance and recording identity do not independently validate the claimed source of messages.

Direct video playback was not watched. Content classifications rely on explicit official descriptions, organizational announcements, library cataloguing or indexed metadata. Secondary presentations are marked unresolved.
